subject: Request for official transcript
body: I am writing to request an official copy of my academic transcript for the M.Sc. programme completed in 2024, enrolment number MS2022-1187.

The transcript is required for an overseas application with a deadline of 30 September 2026. I would be grateful if it could be issued at the earliest convenience; the applicable fee has been paid online, receipt enclosed.
Please let me know if any further documentation is needed.
